headword: {一長一短|いっちょういったん}

definitions.gloss: pros and cons, merits and demerits
definitions.explanation: Having both good and bad points. Literally: one long, one short.

examples.japanese: どちらの{方法|ほうほう}にも{一長一短|いっちょういったん}がある。
examples.english: Both methods have their pros and cons.

examples.japanese: {都会|とかい}{暮|く}らしには{一長一短|いっちょういったん}がある。
examples.english: Living in the city has its advantages and disadvantages.

examples.japanese: {一長一短|いっちょういったん}を{比|くら}べて{決|き}めた。
examples.english: I compared the pros and cons and decided.

notes: A common 四字熟語 used when evaluating options. Literally: one strong point, one weak point. Often used with がある (there are). Useful for expressing that nothing is perfect.
